gate: M1-M4 retained heap across repeated island laps
rule: M1 needs >= 6 SAMPLED laps to compute a first-half versus second-half median growth ratio. No attempt reached lap 3. The instrument wrote NO record on any attempt, so there is nothing to score and nothing is scored.
whyNotAFail: A heap FAIL would be a statement about memory growth. No growth series exists: the instrument aborted before one could be formed. Recording NOT-CAPTURED rather than FAIL is the difference between 'the city leaks' and 'this vehicle could not measure whether it leaks', and only the second is supported.

capReDerivationWasCorrectAndUnusedInTheE.note: The cap was re-derived to 150 minutes before any lap ran, because the three-tier floor of 73.5 min would have left the inherited 75-minute cap firing on a healthy slow run. In the event no attempt survived long enough for either cap to matter. The derivation stands on its own arithmetic and is recorded; it did not decide anything here.
capReDerivationWasCorrectAndUnusedInTheE.flagAdded: scripts/citywide-heap-repeat-cli.mjs gained an optional --lap-phase-cap-ms following the precedent --out itself set: the default is unchanged, so nothing that ran before behaves differently. It refuses a non-positive value and refuses to combine with the FROZEN default output root.

attempts.reason: The CLI requires a SEPARATELY LAUNCHED dedicated Chrome on port 9223 with --js-flags=--expose-gc; none was running, so the CDP connect refused. No lap ran.

Reached lap 2 of 9, then the instrument's own fail-closed guard fired: 'street-260m-lower: focus/visibility changed mid-run (hasFocus true -> false)'. A retained-heap sample taken while the renderer is backgrounded measures a different quantity, so the guard refuses it.
Same guard at lap 1 'transition-1200m-anchor', after every other scratch Chrome on the machine had been killed and the dedicated one relaunched clean.

vehicleLimitation.statement: THIS VEHICLE CANNOT HOLD A ~45-MINUTE EXCLUSIVE-FOCUS MEASUREMENT WHILE AN AGENT DRIVES THE MACHINE.
vehicleLimitation.detail: M1 requires one Chrome window to remain frontmost and visible for 9 laps across 5 poses. The machine is simultaneously running an Orca embedded browser and being driven through a shell by an agent. The guard that fired is precisely a 'something else touched the desktop' detector, and it fired twice from different laps, which is the signature of an ambient condition rather than a specific action.
vehicleLimitation.whatWouldFixIt: A dedicated session with no other browser and no interactive driver, or a headless variant of the instrument whose sampling does not depend on window focus. The second is an instrument change and was not attempted here.
vehicleLimitation.notRetriedFurther: STOPPING RULE, AND ITS PROVENANCE STATED HONESTLY. This was an IN-CAMPAIGN JUDGEMENT, not a pre-registered rule: the pre-registration's abort classification names landing failures and M2 violations but says nothing about how many focus-guard aborts are enough. I stated the rule mid-campaign, before attempt 3's outcome was known -- 'if it focus-aborts again, record M1 NOT-CAPTURED with the vehicle-limitation reason' -- and the coordinator confirmed it. An earlier revision of this record called it pre-registered. It was not, and describing an in-flight judgement as a pre-registration is exactly the kind of retrospective tidying this campaign exists to avoid. The judgement itself stands: retrying until a run happens to survive would select for a quiet desktop rather than measure the city.

interimReadingsReportedNotScored.statement: REPORTED, NOT A VERDICT. These are the samples the aborted runs did take. They are published because suppressing them would hide the only heap evidence this campaign produced, and labelled because two-and-a-bit laps cannot answer a gate that needs six.
interimReadingsReportedNotScored.observation: Across attempt 2's four sampled points the retained heap moved 952.7 -> 993.0 -> 959.2 -> 981.5 MB: oscillating within about 4 per cent, not climbing monotonically. Resident cells held at 8 at every pose in both runs and 'released' rose monotonically (0 -> 3,934), so the scheduler was releasing rather than accumulating. NONE OF THAT IS A PASS: M1 is a growth-ratio gate over 8 sampled laps and the series never reached one.

m2Condition: Never reached. M2 requires activeRequests === 0 at each sample; no attempt got far enough for the condition to be exercised as a verdict.
nonClaims: This is not evidence that the three-tier city leaks, and not evidence that it does not.
One machine, one session, AC power.
The interim samples are a handful of points from aborted runs and carry no growth conclusion.
